description.en: The ID of the IP address whitelist template.

title.zh: 跨产品白名单模板绑定/解绑接口

descriptions.zh:
- 使用阿里云或DAS的SDK时，建议使用最新版本。
- 在使用SDK调用DAS服务时，需要将地域指定为cn-shanghai。
- 目前支持的数据库实例请参见SQL洞察和审计的[功能概览](~~92561~~)。
- 目标数据库实例已开启SQL洞察和审计（旧版）功能，开启方法请参见[开启SQL洞察和审计](~~92561~~)。
descriptions.en:
- Use the latest version of the Alibaba Cloud or DAS software development kit (SDK).

- When you use the SDK to call the DAS service, set the region to cn-shanghai.

- For more information about the supported database instances, see [Overview of features](~~92561~~) for SQL Insight and Audit.

- The SQL Insight and Audit (Legacy) feature is enabled for the destination database instance. For more information about how to enable this feature, see [Enable SQL Insight and Audit](~~92561~~).

example.unifiedCli: aliyun das modify-security-ip-group-relation --region-name cn-shanghai --instance-id pc-bp1u5mas9exx70000 --global-security-group-id g-ggh7qvrrwikyxe0000 --region cn-hangzhou
